policy: Only publicly verified submission requirements are encoded as facts. Missing public requirements must be confirmed with the commissioning editor before submission.

publishers.name: Springer Nature — Computer Science
publishers.route: Submit Book Idea / publishing editor matching
publiclyVerifiedRequirements: Submit the book idea through Springer Nature's book-idea route.
Explain target audience and need for the book.
Position the project against competing or related books without claiming there is no competition.
Demonstrate fit with the publisher's computer-science programme.

publishers.name: CRC Press / Taylor & Francis
publishers.route: Contact the appropriate subject Commissioning Editor
publiclyVerifiedRequirements: Submit to one Taylor & Francis editor at a time; editors can redirect internally.
Articulate a clear unique selling point, demand and author expertise.
A subject-specific proposal form may be supplied by the editor.
Proposals that progress undergo external peer review before final approval.
publishers.peerReview: external-peer-review; public FAQ advises allowing at least four weeks

publishers.name: Wiley-IEEE Press
publishers.route: IEEE Press Professional Book Proposal Form
publiclyVerifiedRequirements: Use the IEEE Press Professional Book Proposal Form for a professional/research-oriented book.
The proposal must explain the type of book, why it is being written and how it will be structured.
Completed proposal forms are sent to IEEE Press acquisitions staff at the address published by IEEE Author Center.
Acceptance considers need, market research and cost analysis, with expert consultation.

publishers.name: RA-MA Editorial
publiclyVerifiedRequirements: Índice completo de contenidos.
Uno o dos capítulos.
Información sobre la extensión prevista.
Plazo de finalización del proyecto.
El archivo adjunto del formulario debe ser PDF y no superar 30 MB.

publishers.name: Ediciones Paraninfo
publiclyVerifiedRequirements: La línea Universidad publica libros de texto, guías profesionales y monografías.
Ciencias de la Computación figura entre sus materias editoriales.
Existe un canal específico para autores y un contacto editorial público.
